# The China-Global South Project

> > Independent analysis and commentary on China's engagement with Africa and the Global South, covering diplomacy, investment, infrastructure, and bilateral relations.

Founded by Eric Olander, this platform provides nuanced reporting on China-Africa relations, Chinese investment patterns, development finance, public diplomacy initiatives, and geopolitical dynamics across the African continent. The project examines everything from infrastructure projects and tech startups to diplomatic incidents and energy trade.

## Key Topics

- China-Africa Relations
- Chinese Investment & Venture Capital
- Development Finance & Debt
- Public Diplomacy & Wolf Warrior Diplomacy
- Infrastructure Projects (SGR, Big Four)
- African Tech & E-commerce
- Energy Trade & Oil Imports
- COVID-19 Response & Health Diplomacy
- Guangzhou Discrimination Crisis
- Key Figures: Eric Olander, Lin Songtian, Zhao Baogang
- Key Countries: Kenya, South Africa, Nigeria, Zimbabwe, Ethiopia, DRC
- Huawei & Telecom Investment
- African Migrants in China
- US-China Competition in Africa
